subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently overwriting [AI-assisted]model-selection: warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently …

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve shipped last-match selection while warning, or may this PR intentionally switch existing duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is straightforward, but changing which provider/model wins for existing config is a compatibility and auth-provider routing decision that should come from maintainers.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
options.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and add equivalent alias-index coverage.

options.title: Approve First-Match Precedence
options.body: Accept the compatibility break only with explicit upgrade proof and release-note context for provider/model rerouting.

options.title: Pause For A Unified Replacement
options.body: Close or pause this branch in favor of one coherent fix that covers both resolver paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
recommendation.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and add equivalent alias-index coverage.
